title: Excavator Activity Recognition: Multi-Sensor IMU Dataset from Post-Earthquake Demolition Operations
description: Accelerometer, gyroscope and magnetometer data (50 Hz, MbientLab MetaMotion IMU) recorded on an excavator during post-earthquake demolition operations after the 6 February 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquakes (Türkiye), with activity labels (demolition, grading, loading, waiting) derived from synchronized video. Supports the article 'Deep Learning-Based Classification of Excavator Activities from Multi-Sensor Motion Data in Post-Earthquake Demolition Operations' (Canadian Journal of Civil Engineering).
